resources.string: The complete backup will be checked first. Conversations are merged; existing entries are not overwritten. Conflicting entries are restored as new copies. Reading settings are not part of this backup.
Use the saved original with the current parser. The title and pin are preserved, and the previous version is retained for recovery. Position and bookmarks may reset if message boundaries change.
Automatic detection works for standard exports. Choose a format if the original is ambiguous.
Very long lines are shortened in this preview. Save the original file to access the exact, complete content.
The operation could not finish. Check available storage and file access, then try again. Existing records are retained.
%1$d records could not be read. Their files have been retained; other conversations remain available. Reimport the original or restore a valid backup. No damaged record has been deleted.
